conditions: The enclosing construct causes default initialization. For a controlled subcomponent, the rule applies when no initial value has been assigned under §3.3.1.
limitations: This is the manual's default-initialization rule. Paragraph 12 has additional sequencing for access-discriminant components and allocators. Paragraphs 22/2–27/2 describe an omission permission under stated conditions for nonlimited controlled objects.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: The Ada 2022 Reference Manual calls Initialize on a default-initialized controlled object as a whole and on any controlled subcomponent without an assigned initial value. It places an object's Initialize call after initialization of its subcomponents.
